evidence_snippets: A modified Flex Template Dockerfile might look like the following example: FROM gcr.io/dataflow-templates-base/python3-template-launcher-base ENV FLEX TEMPLATE PYTHON PY FILE = "/template/main.py" COPY . /template If you use a requirements file, pre-install the requirements.txt.
